THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEW SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 16, 1935

NOTICE

Captain Walter Heikel, formerly of
the Yangtse Rapid S.S. Co. has re-
turned to China and now represents
the following Finnish business
houses:
ARES MOTOR FACTORY
ALINKO TRADING CO.
TORNATOR CO.
ENZO-GUTZEIT CO.
P. GENMAN
NOVO MANSIO
E. M. NORDQUIST CO.
TAMMERFORS WALLPAPER
FACTORY
D. WINTER & CO.
JOHN SUNDWELL & CO.
UUNO RIKKONEN
NASIJARVEN CARTOON
FACTORY
RAF. HAARLA
FINLAND PAK
PARACHUTES
FINNISH SAWBLADE
FACTORY

Capt. Heikel's present address is
c/o Finnish Consulate, 301 Route
Cardinal Mercier, to which all en-
quiries for the present should be
addressed.

ALINKO 贸易公司
TORNATOR 公司
ENZO-GUTZEIT 公司
P. GENMAN
NOVO MANSIO
E. M. NORDQUIST 公司
坦佩雷（Tammerfors）壁纸厂
D. WINTER 公司
JOHN SUNDWELL 公司
UUNO RIKKONEN
纳西耶尔维（Nasijarven）纸箱厂
RAF. HAARLA
FINLAND PAK
降落伞
芬兰锯条厂

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
Special Branch S.2. XXXXX
No. D 3506.
Date May 17, 19 32.
Date 17 / 5 / 32.

Subject (in full)............................................................ Walter Alfred Heikel.

Made by... D.S. Moore. .................................................... Forwarded by....................................................................

Further enquiries made in connection with the above
named Finnish subject have elicited the following: Since
joining the staff of the Yangtsze Rapids Company, Heikel has by
his own actions and behaviour earned the reputation of being a
steady, sober and utterly reliable man. During his frequent
trips up river he invariably stays on board when calling at the
various towns en route and is renowned amongst the up river
shipping fraternity for this peculiarity. This practice he also
carries out whilst in Shanghai and very rarely comes ashore in
this port, seeming to be perfectly content to remain on board
his ship. Local shipping circles have heard rumours that
Heikel was at one time connected with the Communist Party
previous to his advent to the Far East but are of the opinion that
by his present actions he is trying to live down the rumour and to
rid himself of the stigma attached to the word Communist.

W.B. Moore
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2, The Finnish Consul-General
is rather concerned about Heikel. Please
let him know the result of your inquiries
A.S. Moore. as indicated.
Finnish Consul-General informed J.S.R. 19/5. 18:5:32.
of the above on May 19th.
Officer i/c S.B. J.S.R. 19/5. W.B.M. 19/5. File 9/5

日期 1932年5月17日。

主题（全称）............................................................ 沃尔特·阿尔弗雷德·海克尔（Walter Alfred Heikel）。

制作人... D.S. 摩尔（Moore）。 .................................................... 转发人....................................................................

针对上述芬兰籍人士进行的进一步调查获得了以下情况：自从加入长江急流轮船公司（Yangtsze Rapids Company）以来，海克尔以其自身的行动和表现赢得了稳重、清醒且完全可靠的声誉。在他频繁的上游航行途中，每当停靠沿途各城镇时，他总是留在船上，并因此在长江上游航运界因这一特点而闻名。他在上海期间也遵循这一做法，极少在此港口上岸，似乎完全满足于留在他的船上。当地航运界曾听闻谣言，称海克尔在来到远东之前曾一度与共产党有联系，但认为他正通过目前的行动努力消除这一谣言的影响，并摆脱“共产党”一词所附带的污名。

W.B. 摩尔（Moore）
D. S.

特别分部主管警官。

S2，芬兰总领事对海克尔颇为关切。请按指示让他知晓你的调查结果
A.S. 摩尔（Moore）。
芬兰总领事已于5月19日获知上述情况。J.S.R. 19/5。18:5:32。
特别分部主管警官 J.S.R. 19/5。W.B.M. 19/5。档案 9/5

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
9506.
Special Branch Station:
H. H. 32
Date April 14, 1932.

Subject (in full) Walter Alfred Heikel.

Made by L. S. Moore. Forwarded by O. A. Everett

Information has been received, that the above named
Finnish subject who was born in 1877, was at one time, according
to his own confession, a paid agent of the Communist Party.
It appears that following the Great War, Heikel resided in
Belgrade and was appointed Honorary Finnish Consul in that city.
In the early part of 1925 he was recalled to Finland and in
July of the same year was arrested by the Finnish Police as a
suspected communist. He then confessed that he had been in
the pay of the Communist Party from 1923 to 1925, receiving
at first Gpl35 per month and later Gpl75 per month. He was
released by the Finnish Authorities without trial and is believed
to have come to the Far East in 1928 and for about the past four
years has been employed by the Yangtsze Navigation & Steamship Co. in
which firm he holds the position of Captain of one of their
river steamers.

Heikel is not known to have been engaged in communist
activities since residing in the Far East, but in view of the
prevalence of communism in the Yangtsze Valley at the present
time, the above information is forwarded for consideration.

W. B. Moore
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2. Please endeavour obtain further
information about his present activities.
O. S. Moore.
As requested.
15/4/32.

日期 1932年4月14日。

主题（全称） 沃尔特·阿尔弗雷德·海克尔（Walter Alfred Heikel）。

制作人 L. S. 摩尔（Moore）。 转发人 O. A. 埃弗雷特（Everett）

收到情报称，上述出生于1877年的芬兰籍人士，据其本人供认，曾一度是共产党的受薪代理人。看来，第一次世界大战后，海克尔居住在贝尔格莱德，并被任命为该市的名誉芬兰领事。1925年初，他被召回芬兰，并于同年7月因涉嫌为共产主义者而被芬兰警方逮捕。随后他供认，在1923年至1925年间一直受雇于共产党，起初每月领取35金镑（Gpl），后来每月领取75金镑（Gpl）。他被芬兰当局未经审判即释放，据信于1928年来到远东，并在过去约四年间受雇于扬子江航运轮船公司（Yangtsze Navigation & Steamship Co.），在该公司担任其一艘内河轮船的船长职务。

自居住在远东以来，未发现海克尔参与共产党活动，但鉴于目前长江流域共产主义盛行，特上报上述信息以供考量。

W. B. 摩尔（Moore）
D. S.

特别分部主管警官。

S2. 请设法获取有关其目前活动的更多信息。
O. S. 摩尔（Moore）。
遵命。
1932年4月15日。
1932年4月14日。
